title: ProjectionUnsupportedFeatureV1
description: One thing a projection declined to represent, reported rather than guessed at. The vocabulary is closed: a projection may only admit a limitation the contract already names, so a new kind of silence about the music cannot be introduced by writing a new string. canonical_event_id and start_tick are optional because some limitations belong to a derived artifact (a rest the builder computed) rather than to any canonical event.
